bead.title: Add hybrid async crash chaos coverage
bead.description: Add crash/chaos coverage for the converged plan. In-scope files: crates/pqueue-sqlite/tests/*, crates/pqueue-objectlog/tests/*, crates/pqueue-server/tests/server.rs or new focused tests. Cover crash after object-log commit before memory apply, after memory apply before SQLite apply, during SQLite transaction before high-water, after high-water commit, before response delivery, disk-loss, disk-full if reasonably simulatable, async backlog/backpressure, and request_id replay after each relevant window. Assert no lost/duplicate leases, no orphaned in-flight records, and no high-water advance past poison. Out of scope: 10M performance run.
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite hybrid_async_chaos -- --nocapture` passes.
2. `cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog hybrid_async_chaos -- --nocapture` passes.
3. `cargo test -p pqueue-server --test server objectlog_hybrid_async -- --nocapture` passes.
4. `cargo test --workspace --all-features` passes.
5. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
